name: Atlas (electric)
description: All-electric bipedal humanoid from Boston Dynamics. Research and pre-production platform; not commercially available.

name: Optimus Gen 2
description: Tesla general-purpose humanoid. Second generation, in-house actuators. Not commercially available.

name: Figure 02
description: Figure AI's second-generation commercial humanoid, piloting in logistics and manufacturing settings.

name: H1
description: Unitree's full-size bipedal humanoid. Commercially available, popular research platform.

name: G1
description: Unitree's compact humanoid, 127cm tall. Best price-to-capability ratio in the humanoid bucket and a growing sim-to-real community.

name: Digit
description: Bipedal humanoid from Agility Robotics, deployed in warehouse logistics pilots (e.g. GXO, Amazon).

name: NEO
description: 1X Technologies' consumer humanoid, designed for home tasks. Tendon-driven actuators.

name: Apollo
description: Commercial humanoid from Apptronik, targeting warehouse and manufacturing tasks. Collaborator on NASA Valkyrie lineage.

name: Phoenix
description: Sanctuary AI's Phoenix humanoid, 7th generation as of 2024. Bimanual general-purpose manipulation.

name: GR-1
description: Fourier Intelligence's full-size research humanoid, sold to universities and research labs.

name: Walker X
description: UBTech's bipedal service humanoid, demonstrated in retail and exhibition settings.

name: Iron
description: XPENG's bipedal humanoid announced in 2024, sharing autonomy stack with the company's EVs.

name: Ameca
description: Expressive humanoid upper body from Engineered Arts, widely used in HRI research and exhibits.

name: Oli / CL-series
description: LimX Dynamics humanoid family. Sold to research groups; no publicly distinguished SKU catalog yet, tracked here as a single family row per spec 017 decision 4.

name: T1
description: Booster Robotics T1 bipedal humanoid. Compact research platform out of China.

name: K2 Forerunner
description: Kepler Robotics K2 Forerunner humanoid. Early-stage commercial program aimed at industrial tasks.

name: Galbot G1
description: Mobile humanoid upper body from Galbot (Galaxy General), wheeled base plus dual arms. Distinct SKU from Unitree G1 per spec 017 decision 4.

name: 4NE-1
description: NEURA Robotics 4NE-1 humanoid, announced 2024. Integrates NEURA's cognitive control stack.

name: MenteeBot V3
description: Mentee Robotics MenteeBot V3, research humanoid out of Israel co-founded by Lior Wolf and Amnon Shashua.

name: NAO6
description: Aldebaran NAO6, 58cm bipedal humanoid widely used in education, RoboCup, and HRI research.

name: Pepper
description: Aldebaran Pepper, 121cm wheeled-base social humanoid originally by SoftBank. Widely deployed in retail and research.

name: TIAGo Pro
description: PAL Robotics TIAGo Pro mobile manipulator — humanoid upper body on a wheeled base, commonly used in service and research contexts.

name: Spot
description: Boston Dynamics Spot, commercially available legged quadruped for inspection and research. Optional Spot Arm for mobile manipulation.

name: Go2
description: Unitree Go2, compact legged quadruped with 12 actuated joints. Best price-to-capability ratio for legged locomotion research.

name: ANYmal
description: ANYbotics ANYmal, IP67-rated autonomous legged quadruped for industrial inspection.

name: X30
description: DEEP Robotics X30 all-weather quadruped for industrial inspection, power grid, and fire/rescue.

name: Vision 60
description: Ghost Robotics Vision 60, mid-size legged quadruped targeted at defense and perimeter-security applications.

name: Husky A300
description: Clearpath Husky A300 wheeled UGV. ROS-native research platform for outdoor autonomy and navigation.

name: UR5e
description: Universal Robots UR5e, 6-DoF collaborative arm with 5 kg payload and 850 mm reach. De facto cobot baseline.

name: UR10e
description: Universal Robots UR10e, 6-DoF collaborative arm with 12.5 kg payload and 1300 mm reach. Larger sibling to UR5e.

name: LBR iiwa
description: KUKA LBR iiwa, 7-DoF sensitive collaborative arm with joint torque sensors. Flagship cobot for compliant manipulation.

name: YuMi (IRB 14000)
description: ABB YuMi (IRB 14000), dual-arm 14-DoF collaborative robot designed for small-parts assembly.

name: CRX-5iA
description: FANUC CRX-5iA, 6-axis collaborative robot with 5 kg payload. Smallest SKU in the CRX cobot family.

name: CRX-10iA
description: FANUC CRX-10iA, 6-axis collaborative robot with 10 kg payload. Mid-size SKU in the CRX cobot family.

name: CRX-25iA
description: FANUC CRX-25iA, 6-axis collaborative robot with 30 kg payload. Largest SKU in the CRX cobot family.

name: HC10DTP
description: Yaskawa Motoman HC10DTP, 6-axis collaborative robot with 10 kg payload. IP67 thermal-series variant.

name: M0609
description: Doosan M0609, 6-DoF cobot with 6 kg payload and 900 mm reach. Smallest M-series SKU.

name: M1013
description: Doosan M1013, 6-DoF cobot with 10 kg payload and 1300 mm reach. Mid-size M-series SKU.

name: M1509
description: Doosan M1509, 6-DoF cobot with 15 kg payload and 900 mm reach. High-payload M-series SKU.

name: TM S-series
description: Techman Robot TM S-series cobot, 6-DoF with integrated vision. Omron parent company.

name: Gen3
description: Kinova Gen3 lightweight 7-DoF research arm with wrist camera. Popular ROS research platform.

name: Franka Research 3
description: Franka Research 3, 7-DoF torque-controlled research arm. Successor to Franka Emika Panda. De facto manipulation-research standard.

name: RB-series
description: Rainbow Robotics RB-series cobot. Korean-made collaborative arm family (RB5, RB10, RB16).

name: TX2-90
description: Stäubli TX2-90, 6-axis industrial robot with 20 kg payload. Precision assembly and pharmaceutical applications.

name: VT6L
description: Epson VT6L, 6-axis all-in-one robot with integrated controller and 6 kg payload.

name: MELFA ASSISTA
description: Mitsubishi Electric MELFA ASSISTA, 6-axis collaborative robot with teach-button programming.

name: duAro1
description: Kawasaki duAro1, dual-arm SCARA cobot with shared base. Designed for small-parts assembly.

name: Nova 2
description: Dobot Nova 2, compact 6-DoF collaborative arm with 2 kg payload. Tabletop cobot for light assembly.

name: Stretch 3
description: Hello Robot Stretch 3, compact mobile manipulator on wheeled base. Lifting column, telescoping arm, designed for home and research use.

name: Scout 2.0
description: AgileX Scout 2.0 outdoor wheeled UGV. 4WD skid-steer platform for research and inspection.

name: BellaBot Pro
description: Pudu BellaBot Pro, wheeled hospitality delivery robot with multi-tray payload. Widely deployed in restaurants and hotels.

name: Dinerbot T10
description: Keenon Dinerbot T10, wheeled food-delivery service robot for restaurants.

name: Magician
description: Dobot Magician, 4-axis desktop educational arm. Popular STEM classroom platform with modular end-effectors.

name: myCobot 280
description: Elephant Robotics myCobot 280, 6-DoF desktop educational arm. ROS/Python SDK, low-cost entry to manipulator research.

name: SO-100
description: The Robot Studio SO-100, low-cost 6-DoF tabletop arm. De facto platform for the LeRobot imitation-learning community.

name: Mavic 3 Pro
description: DJI Mavic 3 Pro, prosumer aerial photography drone with triple-camera Hasselblad payload.

name: X10
description: Skydio X10, autonomy-first enterprise drone. Best-in-class obstacle avoidance and onboard AI.

name: Anafi Ai
description: Parrot ANAFI Ai, 4G-connected research drone with open SDK. Popular with academic autonomy groups.

name: EVO II
description: Autel EVO II Pro, enterprise inspection drone with 6K camera. NDAA-compliant alternative to DJI.

name: Starling 2
description: ModalAI Starling 2, PX4-native research drone with onboard VIO and obstacle avoidance. Popular with academic autonomy groups.
